text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Yamanin Zephyr!! Pushing 
past a field of formidable rivals, Yamanin 
Zephyr claims the Yasuda Kinen in 
brilliant fashion!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: With this... that's the first one.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. However, I cannot 
simply keep dancing in the fresh breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Let us prepare. For the next stage—the 
race to decide the ultimate tempest.
